questions.questionText: A government introduces tradeable pollution permits to reduce pollution. What is an advantage of this scheme?

options.A: It allows consumers to determine the optimum pollution level.
options.B: It can provide rewards for firms that reduce pollution.
options.C: It enables the government to raise revenue from the resale of permits.
options.D: It uses the market system with no administrative costs.

questions.questionText: To reduce traffic congestion, a government built a new highway. A majority of the citizens were opposed to this. Some citizens responded by switching from public transport to private cars. This caused car journeys to take even longer. What can be concluded about government failure in this case?

options.A: It occurred because the government‘s opportunity costs were not considered.
options.B: It occurred because the wishes of the majority of citizens were ignored.
options.C: It occurred because the result was unintended.
options.D: It occurred from over-reliance on the market system.
